subject: Marketplace variantization & geo entitlements — Acme POC and co-sell asks
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@aws-partner.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@microsoft.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudvendor.co>, Priya Singh <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace variantization & geo entitlements — Acme POC and co-sell asks

Team / partners,

Starting a short thread to align on how we want to package Redwood offers across AWS/Azure/GCP for the upcoming Acme Analytics POC and the broader co-sell ask. Attached is an initial matrix (marketplace-variant-matrix-v1.xlsx) with a proposal — please review and flag any non-starters.

Top-level goals:
- Keep a single canonical API surface for customers, but ship clear listing variants per cloud when required by marketplace rules or partner co-sell criteria.
- Minimize SKU explosion: prefer feature flags/plan bands rather than one SKU per micro-variation.
- Be explicit about geo entitlements: which SKUs are allowed in US/EU/APAC and which require Private/Dedicated.

Decision points we need by EOD Dec 3 (prefer concrete yes/no):
1) Variant naming: Base / Enterprise / Dedicated — good as-is?
2) Per-cloud constraints: any marketplace that *requires* a separate SKU per region or per VM type?
3) Co-sell gating: what listing metadata will partners look for to trigger GTM support?

Quick asks for partners: Miguel/Claire/Raj — can you call out any hard constraints (listing IDs, pricing parity requirements, or geo gating) that would force a different approach for your marketplace?

Acme (Priya) — can you confirm the initial POC regions (US-EAST, EU-WEST) and if APAC is required for this first phase?

Thanks — I think if we lock down the variant map this week, Marissa can draft listing docs and the partner team can open co-sell requests.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: marketplace-variant-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@aws-partner.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@microsoft.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudvendor.co>, Priya Singh <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace variantization & geo entitlements — Acme POC and co-sell asks

Neha — thanks for the clear kickoff. A couple of notes from AWS Marketplace side:

- AWS prefers one listing with multiple availability regions rather than many region-bound SKUs, but there are exceptions: if you want to qualify for specific co-sell programs we sometimes need a SKU that is tied to AMI/instance SKU or a Private Offer (for Reserved/BYOL models).
- Pricing parity: AWS will surface pricing in a way that makes cross-cloud parity visible to customers — consistent naming + a base price band helps avoid confusion.
- Co-sell eligibility: we'll require a marketing one-pager and a completed AWS Partner co-sell intake (I can kick this off) — listing IDs and co-sell approval are separate.

Practical asks:
1) If you plan Dedicated as an SKU, please call it "Dedicated (BYO)" and include expected instance families — that helps our teams map procurement.
2) Send the final feature-to-variant mapping (I can accept XLSX or CSV).

I attached a short doc with AWS portal checklist that lists items that *must* be present. Happy to meet to run through the list. We can support US and CA for co-sell in Q1; EU is doable but will need separate tracing for data-residency options.

— Miguel
Miguel Torres
AWS Partner GTM Lead
[Attachment: aws-portal-reqs.pdf (doc)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@aws-partner.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@microsoft.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudvendor.co>, Priya Singh <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace variantization & geo entitlements — Acme POC and co-sell asks

Thanks Miguel — couple of internal clarifications from our end after reviewing the matrix: we agree with limiting SKU count but operational constraints drive a small set of per-cloud variants. Recommended baseline: 

- Base (hosted, multi-tenant): available in all regions where we operate. No region-specific SKU.
- Enterprise: higher limits + SSO + audit logs; publish in US/EU.
- Dedicated (BYO): listed as a separate variant only when partners require instance-level mapping (AWS AMI / Azure VM offer / GCP image).

Notes: 
- EU: treat as a special entitlement only for Enterprise and Dedicated (data residency). For Base in EU we will require a privacy addendum and an EU data processing clause.
- APAC: operationally we want to gate GA to Q2 2027 unless a strategic partner (like Acme) needs it for a paid POC.

Cost/capex impact: Dedicated will add 25–40% uplift to the unit price — call this out in the listing metadata so partners can easily filter.

Action items I can take this week:
- Convert the attached Redwood-offer-tiles.csv into the listing-friendly metadata schema (owner: Soojin).
- Draft a regional rollout plan that shows phase 1 (US/EU) and phase 2 (APAC).

Priya — for Acme's POC, if APAC is a hard requirement please confirm and we'll escalate.

Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace variantization & geo entitlements — Acme POC and co-sell asks

Thanks — quick answers from Acme side:
- POC regions: US-EAST and EU-WEST only. APAC is not required for the initial POC, but we will need APAC support for Q2 if the POC converts.
- Procurement question: do we need "Dedicated" for compliance? Our procurement team says Dedicated is preferred for Enterprise customers who require SOC2 + privacy contract addenda. For the POC we can accept Base with an addendum.

Can you also confirm trial SKUs and if we can run a 30-day hosted trial visible via the marketplace (we prefer to have an auto-provisioned trial SKU so engineering can self-serve). Procurement contact is priya.procurement@acmeanalytics.com.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Singh
VP, Product | Acme Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@aws-partner.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@microsoft.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudvendor.co>, Priya Singh <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace variantization & geo entitlements — Acme POC and co-sell asks

Folks — thanks for the quick inputs. Finalizing decisions here so ops can start drafting listings and partner teams can open co-sell requests: 

Decisions (final):
- Variants: Base / Enterprise / Dedicated (BYO). Naming locked.
- Region mapping: Base = all available regions (but EU Base requires DPA); Enterprise = US/EU; Dedicated = listed where partner marketplace requires instance-level mapping (AWS private offers, Azure VM offer). APAC will be phase 2 unless Acme requests early inclusion (Priya confirmed not for POC).
- Trials: create a 30-day hosted trial SKU under Base for marketplace self-service (owner: Marissa).
- Pricing metadata: include a "Dedicated uplift" field (25–40%) in listing metadata for partner filter.

Immediate next steps:
1) Marissa to create the draft listing docs and share by Dec 10 (Attachment: final-variant-mapping-20261207.xlsx).
2) Soojin to produce listing metadata payload for each cloud and hand to partners (ETA Dec 8).
3) Miguel/Claire/Raj to confirm any portal-specific IDs and open co-sell intake before Dec 15.
4) Neha to coordinate Acme procurement handoff (Priya.procurement@acmeanalytics.com).

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Dec 9 to walk through the draft listing and the co-sell intake process — invite to follow.

Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Marketplace | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: final-variant-mapping-20261207.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
